title: Manga Mavericks Books, Omoi License Georgie Manga in English
content: Manga Mavericks Books , the publishing division of the Manga Mavericks website and podcast, and digital manga publisher Omoi announced on Monday that they have jointly licensed Man Izawa and Yumiko Igarashi 's Georgie ( Georgie! ) manga for release in English.

title: Crunchyroll’s Next Major Webtoon Confirms New 2027 Release After Big Delay – Watch the Trailer
content: The anime adaptations of major webtoons have become a recent trend, with Crunchyroll licensing several titles. One of the most anticipated series, Eleceed , which was announced last year, has finally locked in its release date after a delay.

title: Crunchyroll India Adds All Episodes of One Piece Anime
content: The company added the first 325 episodes of the One Piece anime in India on September 24. Crunchyroll began streaming the anime's Elbaph arc in India on April 5. The Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Netflix is streaming the arc in India as well.

title: R!N (Gemie) Performs in Bengaluru at Japan Habba 2027
content: Singer May Nakabayashi , best known as the singing voice of Macross Frontier 's Sheryl Nome under her stage name May'n , will be the headliner for the 2027 event and the event will also host voice actor Kanna Nakamura as a guest. The event will host Love Live! Sunshine!! voice actress Kanako Takatsuki as a guest.
